title: Industrial blue/white B2B packaging manufacturer single-page marketing site

requirements.summary: Implement a consistent industrial blue/white visual theme (typography, spacing, buttons, section styling, icon style).
acceptanceCriteria: Site uses a consistent blue/white palette with an industrial/business visual style across all pages/sections
Primary and secondary button styles are consistent and accessible (contrast, hover/focus states)
Layout looks professional on desktop and mobile (no overlapping or clipped content)

file_operations.description: Create global styling foundation for the blue/white industrial theme using Tailwind base layers (CSS variables, typography scale, spacing defaults, focus rings, smooth scrolling).
Tune theme tokens (colors/radius/shadows/typography defaults) to align with the industrial blue/white brand and ensure consistent UI states across the single-page layout.

Add small theme helper exports (e.g., className constants for section backgrounds, container widths, icon styling) to ensure consistent styling across sections without modifying immutable shadcn/ui files.

requirements.summary: Build the single-page structure with header navigation, five sections, smooth in-page navigation, and a footer.
acceptanceCriteria: Header navigation links scroll/jump to the correct section (Homepage, About, Products, Why Choose Us, Contact)
A footer is present with basic company contact details and quick links
All user-facing text is in English

file_operations.description: Create the main single-page layout composing Header + sections (Home, About, Products, Why Choose Us, Contact) + Footer; wire section ids and ensure all copy is in English.

Implement a sticky header with navigation links that trigger smooth scrolling to section anchors; use shadcn-ui Button component for consistent interactive styling. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a footer with basic contact details (phone/email) and quick links that scroll to sections; ensure accessible link/focus styles.
Add a lightweight hook/utility to scroll and focus the target section (supports smooth scrolling and keyboard accessibility when navigating by header/footer links).

requirements.summary: Create a hero banner with the exact tagline, short intro, and a prominent Contact Us CTA that scrolls to Contact.
acceptanceCriteria: Hero displays the tagline exactly as provided (same punctuation/capitalization)
A short intro paragraph is visible above the fold on desktop
Clicking “Contact Us” moves focus/scroll to the Contact section

file_operations.description: Implement the hero section with the tagline “Strong Packaging. Safe Delivery. Trusted Quality.” exactly, include a short intro paragraph, and a prominent “Contact Us” CTA button that uses the shared scroll-to-section behavior; use shadcn-ui Button for CTA styling consistency. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire HeroSection into the top of the single-page layout and ensure the hero section has the correct anchor id for navigation.

requirements.summary: Add an About Us section with required B2B positioning and explicit mentions (pricing and delivery).
acceptanceCriteria: About Us copy includes: reliability, quality-focused approach, B2B bulk supply, competitive pricing, and timely delivery

file_operations.description: Create About Us section copy that explicitly mentions reliability, quality-focused approach, B2B bulk supply, competitive pricing, and timely delivery; keep layout responsive and aligned with global theme.
Wire AboutSection into the single-page layout with a stable anchor id used by header/footer navigation.

requirements.summary: Create a Products section showing five product categories with short B2B descriptions in a responsive layout.
acceptanceCriteria: All five product categories are shown with clear titles
Each product has a short descriptive line suitable for B2B buyers
Products are presented in a responsive grid/list that works on mobile

file_operations.description: Implement a responsive products grid/list with five categories (Corrugated Boxes, Carton Packaging, Bubble Wrap, Packaging Rolls, Custom Printed Packaging), each with a short B2B-focused description; use shadcn-ui Card for consistent presentation. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire ProductsSection into the single-page layout with a stable anchor id.

requirements.summary: Create a Why Choose Us section highlighting four trust/value points in a mobile-friendly layout.
acceptanceCriteria: All four value points are visible and visually emphasized (e.g., cards or bullet highlights)
Section remains readable and well-spaced on mobile

file_operations.description: Implement four emphasized points (Premium Quality Materials, Bulk Supply Capability, On-Time Delivery, Affordable Pricing) using a responsive card/highlight layout; use shadcn-ui Card for consistent emphasis. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire WhyChooseUsSection into the single-page layout with a stable anchor id.

requirements.summary: Build the Contact section with exact phone/email, exact CTA text, contact form fields with validation, and a WhatsApp button.
acceptanceCriteria: Phone number and email are displayed exactly as provided
CTA text is displayed exactly as provided (same punctuation/capitalization)
Contact form includes fields: Name, Phone, Email, Message, with basic validation and a clear submit button
WhatsApp button opens a WhatsApp chat using the phone number (e.g., wa.me link)

file_operations.description: Create the Contact section showing Phone: 7050223696 and Email: p1204631@gmail.com exactly, include CTA text “Contact us today for bulk orders and custom packaging solutions.” exactly, render a validated form (Name, Phone, Email, Message) and a WhatsApp button linking to wa.me using the phone number; use shadcn-ui Input/Textarea/Button for accessible controls. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire ContactSection into the single-page layout with a stable anchor id; ensure other CTAs (hero/header/footer) can scroll to it.

requirements.summary: Connect the contact form UI to the backend submission capability with non-blocking UX and clear loading/success/error feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: Submitting the form shows a loading state and then a success message on completion
On success, form fields are cleared
On backend error, an error message is shown without losing the entered content

file_operations.description: Add a small frontend client wrapper for calling the existing backend capability described by frontend/src/backend.d.ts (submitContact) using the project’s core-infrastructure connection patterns; keep it focused on contact submission only.

Implement a React Query mutation hook to submit contact messages asynchronously with loading/success/error state; include mapping strategy to pass Name/Email/Message to submitContact and preserve the Phone field by incorporating it into the submitted message text if needed.

Wire the form submit to useSubmitContact; show non-blocking loading state, success confirmation, and inline error feedback while preserving user input on error; clear fields on success; ensure submit remains fast and keyboard accessible.

requirements.summary: Ensure responsive, fast-loading, accessible UI across sections (layout, images, focus states, form controls).
acceptanceCriteria: All sections render properly on common breakpoints (mobile/tablet/desktop)
Images are served in appropriate sizes and do not cause layout shift (dimensions reserved)
Interactive elements are keyboard accessible and have visible focus states

file_operations.description: Add/adjust global responsive defaults (container widths, section spacing, typography scaling) and accessible focus styles; enable smooth scrolling and scroll-margin for anchored sections.
Render the hero banner image with reserved dimensions to avoid layout shift and ensure the hero layout remains readable on small screens.
Ensure the products grid adapts to mobile/tablet/desktop breakpoints and icons render with reserved dimensions for stability.
Ensure form controls have proper labels/aria attributes, visible focus states, and error messaging that is readable and keyboard reachable.

requirements.summary: Add basic SEO metadata and semantic headings for the single-page marketing site (title, description, OG/Twitter, H1/H2 structure).
acceptanceCriteria: Document title and meta description are set to relevant business-focused content
Page uses a single clear H1 and logical H2s for sections
Open Graph and Twitter meta tags are present with consistent title/description

file_operations.description: Add/adjust meta description plus Open Graph and Twitter meta tags appropriate for a packaging manufacturing company; reference generated images for social previews from frontend/public/assets/generated/logo.dim_512x512.png or frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-banner.dim_1920x800.png.
Ensure the hero contains the single page H1 (tagline) and that other sections use logical H2 headings for accessibility and SEO.
Ensure About section uses semantic H2 heading and paragraph structure aligned with SEO and accessibility needs.

requirements.summary: Add generated static images (hero banner, logo, product icons) under frontend/public/assets/generated and render them in the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced by the UI
Hero section uses the generated hero banner image without noticeably degrading performance
Products section uses the generated product icons/illustrations consistently

file_operations.description: Add the generated industrial packaging hero banner asset to be used by the Hero section.
Add the generated logo asset to be used in the header/footer branding.
Add the generated Corrugated Boxes icon asset for the Products section.
Add the generated Carton Packaging icon asset for the Products section.
Add the generated Bubble Wrap icon asset for the Products section.
Add the generated Packaging Rolls icon asset for the Products section.
Add the generated Custom Printed Packaging icon asset for the Products section.
Render the generated logo from frontend/public/assets/generated/logo.dim_512x512.png in the header branding area with appropriate sizing and alt text.
Render the generated hero banner from frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-banner.dim_1920x800.png with performance-friendly sizing and reserved dimensions.

Render each product category icon consistently using the generated assets: frontend/public/assets/generated/product-corrugated.dim_512x512.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/product-carton.dim_512x512.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/product-bubblewrap.dim_512x512.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/product-rolls.dim_512x512.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/product-custom-printed.dim_512x512.png.
